title: Folded Bass
text:
Sound: a bass that starts bright, buzzy and metallic and mellows into a round tone: wavefolding, the 'other' way of making a sound bright.

How it's built: a triangle wave goes through a VCA opened by an envelope, then into Drive with FOLD up. How loud the signal is going into a wavefolder decides how much it folds: so the envelope, by turning the level up and down, makes the tone bright at the start and soft as it decays. A filter after smooths the very top. One voice.

Play: punchy notes; hold some to hear them mellow.

Tweak: FOLD and DRIVE, the envelope's DECAY and SUSTAIN (they now set the brightness as well as the level), the filter's CUTOFF.
